definitions.explanation: A structure or device used to hang and dry laundry, typically outdoors or on a balcony.

examples.japanese: {洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{物干|ものほ}しに{干|ほ}した。
examples.english: I hung the laundry on the drying rack.

examples.japanese: ベランダに{物干|ものほ}しを{設置|せっち}した。
examples.english: I installed a drying rack on the balcony.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}りそうだから、{物干|ものほ}しの{洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{取|と}り{込|こ}んで。
examples.english: It looks like rain, so please bring in the laundry from the drying rack.

examples.japanese: {梅雨|つゆ}の{時期|じき}は{室内|しつない}{物干|ものほ}しが{活躍|かつやく}する。
examples.english: Indoor drying racks come in handy during the rainy season.

examples.japanese: {物干|ものほ}し{竿|ざお}が{古|ふる}くなったので、{新|あたら}しいのを{買|か}いに{行|い}った。
examples.english: The laundry pole was old, so I went to buy a new one.

notes:
RELATED WORDS:
- {物干|ものほ}し{竿|ざお} (laundry pole - the pole part of a drying rack)
- {洗濯|せんたく}ばさみ (clothespin)
- {洗濯物|せんたくもの} (laundry)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {物干|ものほ}しに{干|ほ}す (to hang on the drying rack)
- {物干|ものほ}し{台|だい} (drying rack stand)
- {室内|しつない}{物干|ものほ}し (indoor drying rack)

USAGE NOTE: In Japanese apartments, balconies (ベランダ) typically have built-in {物干|ものほ}し structures. Indoor drying ({部屋干|へやぼ}し) is common during rainy season ({梅雨|つゆ}).
